thread:
max: Observed flaky e2e: Retrofit upload tests on Android emulator sometimes throw "request body is not repeatable" after a retry.

anya: Which okhttp config? retryOnConnectionFailure?

max: kotlin-sdk default client had retryOnConnectionFailure=true; java-sdk was false. parity bug.

lee: also streaming RequestBody from InputStream isn't repeatable. If interceptor blindly retries you get that exception or duplicate uploads.

anya: short fixes: set retryOnConnectionFailure=false by default, detect contentLength==-1 and skip retry, or tag requests with @NoRetry.

max: added tiny sample helper to buffer InputStream to temp file and a note in onboarding doc about idempotency-key for uploads.

lee: nice. also suggest scheduler-backed retries with backoff to avoid dispatcher starvation under high concurrency.

ci-bot: CI started for branch max/fix-retry-defaults (build #256) :gear:
